title: The Blue Dress
subtitle: The question I wasn't supposed to ask
label: From the essay
quote: I find a big ring of blue jeans hanging on a circular rack, and I push between them. I disappear into them and into myself.
alt_text: Public domain painting The Sisters by Wilfrid de Glehn across the top, with the line: I find a big ring of blue jeans hanging on a circular rack, and I push between them. I disappear into them and into myself. From The Blue Dress. Not Plain.

captions.instagram:
“I find a big ring of blue jeans hanging on a circular rack, and I push between them. I disappear into them and into myself.”

I fumble with the dressing room’s cheap lock and run through the quiet department store, for once not caring what anyone may think of me. I run until I’m far enough away that they won’t find me.

From The Blue Dress, on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
